mapper.sql: p.id AS promise_id, p.streamer_id, p.session_id, p.transcript_id, p.content, p.status, p.due_date, s.started_at + (t.start_ms * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') AS detected_at, (SELECT c.id FROM calendar_events c WHERE c.promise_id = p.id AND c.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS calendar_event_id
FROM promises p JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id JOIN transcripts t ON t.id = p.transcript_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS promise_id, p.content, p.due_date, p.status, (SELECT c.id FROM calendar_events c WHERE c.promise_id = p.id AND c.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS calendar_event_id FROM promises p WHERE p.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND p.status IN ('PENDING', 'ON_HOLD') AND p.due_date IS NOT NULL AND p.due_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY p.due_date, p.id
